Please read the relevant #> section(s) in the aggregateFeatures manual page regarding the effects #> of missing values on data aggregation. #> Aggregated: 1/1  lfq_qf <- sync_coldata(lfq_qf, 'protein') # plot = TRUE means we will also get a plot of the number of proteins quantified in each sample protein_retain_mask <- biomasslmb::get_protein_no_quant_mask(   lfq_qf[['peptides_for_summarisation']], min_features=min_peps, plot=TRUE)  lfq_qf[['protein']] <- biomasslmb::mask_protein_level_quant(   lfq_qf[['protein']], protein_retain_mask)

code: test_condition <- function(qf) {   condition <- factor(qf[['protein']]$Condition, levels = c('WT', 'Mutant'))   design <- model.matrix(~ condition)    quant <- assay(qf[['protein']])   n_quant <- sapply(levels(condition), function(g) {     rowSums(!is.na(quant[, condition == g, drop = FALSE]))   })   testable <- apply(n_quant, 1, min) >= 2    fit <- eBayes(lmFit(quant[testable, ], design))   topTable(fit, coef = 'conditionMutant', number = Inf, sort.by = 'none') }  pd_res <- test_condition(lfq_qf) mq_res <- test_condition(mq_qf)  data.frame(   pipeline = c('Proteome Discoverer', 'MaxQuant'),   tested = c(nrow(pd_res), nrow(mq_res)),   significant = c(sum(pd_res$adj.P.Val < 0.05), sum(mq_res$adj.P.Val < 0.05))) #>              pipeline tested significant #> 1 Proteome Discoverer    191          12 #> 2            MaxQuant    126           7 comparison <- merge(pd_res, mq_res, by = 'row.names',                     suffixes = c('.PD', '.MQ')) %>%   dplyr::rename(Protein = 'Row.names') %>%   mutate(called = case_when(     adj.P.Val.PD < 0.05 & adj.P.Val.MQ < 0.05 ~ 'both',     adj.P.Val.PD < 0.05 ~ 'PD only',     adj.P.Val.MQ < 0.05 ~ 'MaxQuant only',     TRUE ~ 'neither'))  nrow(comparison) #> [1] 107 round(cor(comparison$logFC.PD, comparison$logFC.MQ), 3) #> [1] 0.947

text: obj QFeatures object. Integer character. Index name assay analyse. group_cols Character vector. One column names colData(obj) define experimental groups (e.g. c("condition", "treatment")). Multiple columns combined interaction term. min_observed Integer. Minimum number observed (non-missing) values required feature included. Features threshold returned NA. Default: 2. min_missing Integer. Minimum number missing values required feature included. Features missingness uninformative returned NA. Default: 1. store_results Logical. TRUE, scores classifications stored rowData assay within returned QFeatures object. Default: TRUE.

title: Score features by how well missingness can be predicted by experimental condition — condition_miss_score
text: list following elements: scores Named numeric vector per-feature condition missingness scores (Tjur's R^2). summary data.frame per-feature details: n_observed, n_missing, miss_frac, condition_miss_score, condition_miss_class. global named numeric vector dataset-level summaries: mean_condition_miss_score, median_condition_miss_score, prop_condition_structured, prop_condition_independent, prop_uninformative. obj input QFeatures object, optionally results written rowData store_results = TRUE.

title: Score features by how well missingness can be predicted by experimental condition — condition_miss_score
text: Note: proteomics, missingness partly intensity-dependent – low- abundance features likely missing regardless condition. function measures additional, condition-specific component: whether missingness systematically higher conditions others given feature. high score imply missingness purely non-random; low score imply purely random. score feature Tjur's R^2 (discrimination coefficient) logistic regression: missing_indicator ~ group missing_indicator 1 value missing 0 observed, group factor combining specified colData columns. Tjur's R^2 computed difference mean predicted probabilities missing observed values: Tjur's R^2 = mean(P(missing | truly missing)) - mean(P(missing | truly observed)) ranges 0 (discrimination – condition-independent) 1 (perfect discrimination – condition-structured). Logistic regression used preference linear model correct model binary outcome. multiple group_cols provided combined single interaction factor (e.g. condition:timepoint), unique combination levels treated distinct group. Classification thresholds (condition_miss_class): "condition_structured" : Tjur's R^2 >= 0.5 "mixed"                : Tjur's R^2 [0.2, 0.5) "condition_independent": Tjur's R^2 <  0.2 "uninformative"        : excluded due min_observed / min_missing filters thresholds heuristic – inspect score distribution applying fixed cutoffs dataset.

code: # load PD PSM-level output tmt_qf <- QFeatures::readQFeatures(assayData = psm_tmt_clock,   colData = tmt_clock_design,   quantCols = rownames(tmt_clock_design),   name = "psms_raw") #> Checking arguments. #> Loading data as a 'SummarizedExperiment' object. #> Formatting sample annotations (colData). #> Formatting data as a 'QFeatures' object.  # extract the accessions from the contaminant FASTA, in both the prefixed # and bare forms, since the search may not have renamed its entries contaminant_fasta <- system.file(   "extdata", "0602_Universal_Contaminants.fasta.gz", package = "biomasslmb")  contaminant_accessions <- get_contaminant_fasta_accessions(contaminant_fasta) contaminant_accessions <- c(contaminant_accessions,                             sub("^Cont_", "", contaminant_accessions))  # remove contaminants and PSMs without a unique master protein psms_filtered <- filter_features_pd_dda(   obj = tmt_qf[["psms_raw"]],   contaminant_proteins = contaminant_accessions,   filter_contaminant = TRUE,   filter_associated_contaminant = TRUE,   unique_master = TRUE) #> Filtering data... #> 11281 features found from 790 master proteins => Input #> 762 contaminant proteins supplied #> 4949 proteins identified as 'contaminant associated' #> 9785 features found from 746 master proteins => contaminant features removed #> 8956 features found from 727 master proteins => associated contaminant features removed #> 8956 features found from 727 master proteins => PD-labelled 'Contaminants' removed #> 8953 features found from 726 master proteins => features without a master protein removed #> 8822 features found from 648 master proteins => features with non-unique master proteins removed #> 6312 features found from 606 master proteins => features without quantification removed  c(before = nrow(tmt_qf[["psms_raw"]]), after = nrow(psms_filtered)) #> before  after  #>  11281   6312

title: Compute a dataset-level score of condition-predictable missingness using logistic regression — global_condition_miss_score
text: list following elements: tjur_intensity_only Numeric. Tjur's R^2 intensity-model. discrimination missing observed explained feature abundance alone – universal intensity-dependent baseline present proteomics data. tjur_incremental Numeric. increase Tjur's R^2 condition added top intensity. primary quantity interest: condition-predictable missingness beyond intensity already explains. Near zero means missingness purely intensity-driven; positive values indicate condition-specific depletion particular features. tjur_condition_fraction Numeric. fraction total explainable missingness (tjur_full) condition-predictable rather intensity-driven. Ranges 0 (intensity-driven) 1 (condition-predictable). tjur_full Numeric. Tjur's R^2 full model (intensity + condition). Equal tjur_intensity_only + tjur_incremental. lrt_chi2 Numeric. Chi-squared statistic likelihood ratio test full vs intensity-model. lrt_df Integer. Degrees freedom LRT. lrt_pvalue Numeric. P-value LRT – tests whether condition adds significant explanatory power intensity alone. model_intensity fitted intensity-glm object. model_full fitted full glm object. interpretation Character string. Human-readable summary key quantities. n_features Integer. Number features included models. n_obs_total Integer. Total number (feature x sample) rows.

title: Compute a dataset-level score of condition-predictable missingness using logistic regression — global_condition_miss_score
text: mod_intensity : missing ~ intensity mod_full      : missing ~ intensity + group incremental Tjur's R^2 (full - intensity) primary quantity interest: measures missingness can predicted experimental condition beyond feature abundance alone predict. Note: proteomics, intensity-dependent missingness universal – datasets show non-zero intensity-Tjur R^2. incremental term isolates additional, condition-specific component. Tjur's R^2 (discrimination coefficient) computed : mean(P(missing | truly missing)) - mean(P(missing | truly observed)) ranges 0 (discrimination) 1 (perfect discrimination) natural measure well model separates missing observed. Pooled logistic regression (random effects) used preference linear mixed model. per-feature random intercept absorb variance intensity meant explain (low-abundance features low intensity high baseline missingness), suppressing intensity fixed effect. pooled approach analogous detection probability curve (DPC) fitted limpa package. intensity covariate per-feature mean observed intensity, scaled mean 0 sd 1. data log-transformed upstream, set log_transform = TRUE sigmoidal intensity-missingness relationship approximately linear log scale, consistent DPC curves typically modelled. decomposition : tjur_full = tjur_intensity_only + tjur_incremental large tjur_intensity_only small tjur_incremental means missingness driven abundance uniformly across conditions – typical baseline. substantial tjur_incremental means certain features specifically depleted particular conditions beyond overall abundance predict. Important limitation – cancellation opposing condition effects: group coefficients estimated across features simultaneously, function measures whether one condition tends missingness another average across features. captures asymmetric, directional missingness (e.g. condition globally depleted), detect condition effects cancel aggregation. Consider dataset peptide missing entirely condition X peptide B missing entirely condition Y. features missingness entirely predictable condition, opposing condition associations cancel pooled model: condition X sees elevated missingness peptide suppressed missingness peptide B, vice versa condition Y. net group coefficients may near zero, tjur_incremental can close zero even every missing value dataset condition-structured. experiment may contain features opposing condition-missingness patterns – common comparing multiple biological conditions – use condition_miss_index output condition_miss_score instead. condition_miss_index aggregates absolute per-feature Tjur R^2 scores immune cancellation problem. global_condition_miss_score best suited experiments expect missingness directionally consistent across features (e.g. one condition globally lower abundance).

code: # both axes are noisy estimates, so ordinary least squares would give a # slope that depends on which variable is on the x axis x <- rnorm(100) df <- data.frame(x = x + rnorm(100, sd = 0.3),                  y = x + rnorm(100, sd = 0.3))  unlist(tls(y ~ x, df)) #>   intercept       slope  #> -0.02784179  0.95054451   library(ggplot2) ggplot(df, aes(x, y)) +   geom_point() +   geom_smooth(method = tls, formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE) +   theme_biomasslmb()
